summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing non-redemption agreements with third-party investors in connection with an extension of its business combination deadline from September 9, 2026 to September 9, 2027. The company and sponsor agreed to issue up to 1,450,000 Pubco shares (or 483,334 additional if deal closes after June 9, 2027) for investors agreeing not to redeem up to 5,800,000 Class A shares. The special meeting was adjourned to September 8, 2026. This is a SPAC-related transaction mechanic, not a definitive business combination. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and redemption levels.
